criteria.text: When a stale `opencode serve --port=4096` orphan is holding the port, starting the api_server reclaims the port (kills the stale process) and the opencode engine reaches ready state without manual intervention.
criteria.test_id: issue-655-c1: reclaim a stale opencode orphan holding :4096

criteria.text: When a NON-opencode process holds :4096, the api_server does not kill it; it surfaces a clear error naming the occupying PID/command.
criteria.test_id: issue-655-c2: a NON-opencode process holding :4096 is not killed

criteria.text: Unit/integration coverage for the port-probe + stale-detection logic (mock `lsof`/`ps` boundary).
criteria.test_id: issue-655-c3: port-probe + stale-detection logic uses the lsof/ps boundary

criteria.text: Manual smoke: force-quit the app (Activity Monitor) while a session is active, relaunch, confirm Open chat works without a manual `kill`.
criteria.reason: Requires force-quitting the shipped desktop app (untrappable SIGKILL leaving an opencode orphan), then relaunching and opening a task-ready chat. Cannot be exercised inside vitest because it depends on a real orphaned opencode process holding :4096 and the full Flutter->api_server->opencode spawn path. Verified by manual smoke on the next desktop build.
